hero_text: Modern hairdressing and beauty treatments in a refined space – personalised hair, skincare and beauty services.
intro_title: Not a production line. Not a template. Attention shaped around your look.
intro_text: LUMÉA is a demo concept for hair and beauty businesses. A final client site can include custom services, prices, team profiles and real online booking.
services_title: One place. Many ways to glow.
hair_text: Women's and men's cuts, styling, colour, balayage, occasion hair and care treatments.
skin_text: Skin-type-based facials, hydration, cleansing and relaxing beauty rituals.
makeup_text: Day, occasion and event make-up tailored to your own style.
prices_note: All shown prices are demo data only. A real client site can use the salon's own price list and durations.
studio_text: The salon's visual identity is deliberately refined and premium. The goal is more than a pretty website: it should communicate quality before the appointment is even booked.
point1p: We clarify the desired result before the service.
point2p: Clean, calm and modern salon experience.
point3p: The final website can include online calendar booking.
look_quote: A modern salon website should communicate the same things as a great service: precision, style and trust.
booking_title: Let's find the right time for you.

faq1q: Is a consultation needed before hair colouring?
faq1a: For complex colour changes it is recommended so the desired result and hair condition can be assessed first.
faq2q: How should I choose a facial?
faq2a: On a real service, the beautician recommends a treatment based on skin type and current condition.
faq3a: The demo shows a request form, but a real booking system can be integrated for a client.
